from rdflib import Graph

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

with open("/app/solution.sparql") as f:
    query = f.read()

results = list(g.query(query))
print(f"Total results: {len(results)}")
for row in results:
    print(f"  {row.professorName}: {row.countries}")

# Verify expected results
expected = {
    "Orfeas Menis": "GR, US",
    "Pepe Attanasio": "PT, GR",
    "Aristotle Tympas": "GR"
}

assert len(results) == 3, f"Expected 3 results, got {len(results)}"
for row in results:
    name = str(row.professorName)
    countries = str(row.countries)
    assert name in expected, f"Unexpected professor: {name}"
    assert countries == expected[name], f"Expected {expected[name]}, got {countries}"

print("\nAll assertions passed!")
